about_the_game:
This demo is just a slice of the full game. It includes:

  • Access to Floors 1 and 2 of the dungeon.

  • The 2 initial characters to try out (Rebecca and Elias).

  • A sample of the loot system, equipment, classes, and frenzied combat.

Have fun with this free demo, and if you like it, please help me by adding the game to your wishlist!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 / AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with 256 MB VRAM (Intel HD 3000 / AMD Radeon HD 5450 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on low-end PCs and integrated graphics. Optimized for 2D pixel art and large hordes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz (Intel i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with 512 MB VRAM (Intel UHD 630 / AMD Radeon Vega 8 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Smooth performance at 1080p resolution, even during intense hordes. Suitable for modern integrated graphics and low-end dedicated GPUs.
